sources.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: the actual Windows desktop application icon for a general-purpose livestream recording, clip editing and video upload utility, not a mockup. Create one crisp professional, universally recognizable video-creator icon. A large white video frame with a bold right-facing play triangle forms the main silhouette; a clean diagonal cut through part of the frame suggests trimming a video clip; integrate a bold upward upload arrow with the frame's upper-right edge. One small coral-red recording dot supplies the live-recording cue. Combine these familiar symbols into one coherent compact mark, not a row of separate icons. Flat vector-like raster artwork, optical balance, very few solid shapes, thick clean geometry and ample separation so the mark remains recognizable at 16, 24, 32 and 48 pixels. Quiet teal-blue full-bleed opaque solid background, high-contrast white main mark, restrained mint accent and red record dot. The background color fills every pixel to all four straight square edges; software will round the tile corners later. Center the complete mark in the inner 76 percent of this square canvas. No people, faces, anime, mascots, stars, planets, letters, words, numbers, brand logos, borders, decorative scenes, checkerboards, drop shadows, 3D, gradients, textures or watermark. One final standalone icon, front view, 1:1. The image must be fully opaque with a clean solid teal-blue background, including the open space inside the video frame. Do not remove or key out the background.

sources.prompt: Create an original finished raster wallpaper for a quiet professional desktop editing application. Very wide 8:3 composition, 2048x768. Theme: polar daylight, sculpted white snow terrain. An elegant high-key monochrome landscape of a few long smooth snow ridges, clean porcelain-white planes and soft neutral silver-gray shadows, carefully art-directed aerial photography-like landscape, tangible gentle contours with fine natural surface detail only on the far right. The LEFT 66 percent must be calm almost uniform near-white #FAFAFA, empty and bright, reserved for dark native interface labels. Place the distinct terrain folds only in the RIGHTMOST THIRD, their main ridges inside the middle vertical band so they survive a shallow 180px banner crop; sweeping sideways rather than tall peaks. No blue or beige cast. Crisp purposeful image, no fog, blur or excessive fine noise. Restrained, spacious, pristine, not a UI mockup. Original invented geography, not a recognizable location. Do not draw people, characters, mascots, animals, buildings, clothing, butterflies, stars, sun or moon disks, planets, orbs, bokeh, logos, text, watermarks, frames, UI widgets, checkerboards, decorative gradients or a collage. Fully opaque image. No external reference, no named artist imitation.

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make an original wide wallpaper with a SMALLER, fully framed anime SUN GIRL bust on the far right and very generous blank space everywhere else. FRAMING FIRST: 2048x768 canvas, opaque flat #FAFAFA ground. Left 55 percent of the canvas is totally blank flat #FAFAFA. The girl occupies only the rightmost third of the canvas. Leave a BROAD VISIBLE BAND of empty background above the entire head, at least one fifth of the image height; the crown must begin below y=150. Leave blank margins at both sides of the girl too. Show the entire crown, all hair accessories, head, shoulders and upper torso, with lower torso exiting the bottom edge. Do NOT enlarge the face to fill the canvas height. DO NOT CROP OR TOUCH THE TOP OF HER HAIR. A spacious composition, not a tight close-up. Her head including hair is about 340 pixels tall, small enough to fit with abundant air above. Girl centered around x=1600. Flat empty background behind her as well, no halo, no landscape. Style: unmistakable cute Japanese 2D anime shoujo character, large sparkling amber eyes, rounded youthful cheeks, small chin, a tiny one-stroke nose, tiny cheerful open smile. Bold clear outline, simple graphic shapes, flat colors and two-tone hard-edged cel shading, attractive polished television anime key art rather than a realistic illustration. Pale golden-blonde fluffy bangs and loose short twin ponytails with white ribbons, a little gold sun-shaped hair clip. Modest white sailor-collar blouse and white capelet with gold trim, coral bow and simple sun badge. No cleavage, no exposed torso, no hands. Bright, friendly anime girl, not a mature woman, not a queen, not chibi. Avoid realistic eyes, realistic nose and lips, skin texture, painted strands, painterly rendering, airbrushed shading, 3D lighting, elaborate jewelry. Keep warm color on the character only. One entirely original character, no existing anime or VTuber identity, no artist imitation, no reference images. No text, logo, watermark, border, UI, gradients, particles or background ornaments. Remember the most important composition rule: a substantial EMPTY TOP MARGIN above the complete head, unlike a cropped anime close-up.
